name: phone
label: Phone
help: Only the contact with this phone number. For example, +14165550134. A 10-digit number is read as North American.

name: email
label: Email
help: Only contacts with this email address.

name: name
label: Name
help: Only contacts whose name contains this text.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of results to return and work with during one execution cycle.
